CustomField.description: Platform-managed lookup identifying which Gift Commitment Schedule is currently active for this commitment. Populated by the Fundraising engine when a schedule's StartDate arrives (past-or-today), not at insert time. Future-dated schedules leave this field null until the first scheduled payment date is reached — this is the positive-logic behavior: "which schedule is running today," not "which schedule is most recently attached." Do not back-fill in flows or Apex; that overrides the platform's active-vs-pending semantics and breaks reports that filter on CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId != null to identify actively giving commitments. Nightly platform job (also fans out Expected GTs and rolls NextTransactionDate) flips this on the activation date. See docs/npc-automation-notes.md and FQS_Summary__c for the "Schedule starts in the future" failsafe.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The gift commitment schedule currently in force. Platform sets this automatically when a schedule's Start Date is today or earlier. Records with a future Start Date leave this field blank until activation.
